component.description:
What it does Reshapes a list of records inside your data: filtering it, sorting it, changing a field on every record, keeping only some fields, rescaling a number, or reducing the list to a single number. One node performs one operation; chain several to build a pipeline you can follow on the canvas.

How it works Point Array Path at a list in the incoming data, choose the operation, then fill in that operation's fields only - the rest are ignored. The result is added to the data as result, with operation and item_count, and everything that arrived passes through, so components downstream still see the fields they expected. A setting that is missing or not one of the choices, or an Array Path that finds nothing or no list, fails the run with a message saying which, instead of quietly passing the data on unchanged.

Configure
Start with Operation and Array Path, then only that operation's fields:
- filter (default) - keep matching records. Field, operator (equals, not_equals, contains, gt, lt, gte, lte) and value.
- extract - return whatever sits at Array Path.
- transform - change a field on every record. Field, operation (add, multiply, uppercase, lowercase, trim, prefix, suffix) and operand.
- aggregate - reduce the list to one number. Field and function (sum, avg, min, max, count).
- sort - order the records. Field and direction (ascending by default). Records without the field go last.
- select_fields - keep only the fields you name, comma-separated.
- normalize - rescale a numeric field into a range. Field, minimum (0) and maximum (1).

In and out In: data containing a list at Array Path. Out: the same data plus result (the reshaped list, or for aggregate the single value), operation and item_count.

Use it when
- An API returned far more rows than you need and you want the ones that matter.
- You need a total, average or count before a decision step.
- A model expects records in a particular order, or with fewer fields than you have.
component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: adapter
name: JSON Handler
description: >
  Applies one operation - extract, filter, transform, aggregate, sort,
  select_fields or normalize - to the list at Array Path inside request_data
  and adds the result to the data. One operation per node; chain several
  nodes for a multi-step pipeline. A misconfigured node, or an Array Path that
  finds no list, raises and fails the run.

input_ports:
  - port_name: input
    port_type: in
    # The artifact is forwarded straight into the Output constructor and is
    # never dereferenced, so it is welcome but never required.
    artifact_type_input: optional(json)
    artifact_type_output: optional(json)
    # The list is located by the array_path parameter rather than a fixed
    # field name, so no specific inbound key can honestly be declared required.
    # The Output spreads its inbound request_data first
    # (`{**request_data, ...}`), so upstream context survives the hop. Nothing
    # is popped, so there is no _except list.
    response_data_passthrough: request_data
    response_data:
      result: object - The operation's output. A list for every operation except aggregate (a number, or null for avg/min/max of no numbers) and extract (whatever sits at Array Path).
      operation: string - The operation that ran.
      item_count: integer - Length of result when it is a list, otherwise 0.

input_parameters:
  - name: operation
    type: select
    label: Operation
    options: [extract, filter, transform, aggregate, sort, select_fields, normalize]
    default: filter
    required: true
    description: The single operation this node performs.
  - name: array_path
    type: text
    label: Array Path
    required: true
    description: Dot-notation path to the list inside the incoming data, e.g. results.items.
  - name: filter_field
    type: text
    label: Filter Field
    description: The record field the filter tests.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [filter]
  - name: filter_operator
    type: select
    label: Filter Operator
    options: [equals, not_equals, contains, gt, lt, gte, lte]
    default: equals
    description: gt, lt, gte and lte compare numbers; equals compares numbers as numbers and anything else as text.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [filter]
  - name: filter_value
    type: text
    label: Filter Value
    description: The value the field is compared with.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [filter]
  - name: transform_field
    type: text
    label: Transform Field
    description: The record field to change.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [transform]
  - name: transform_op
    type: select
    label: Transform Operation
    options: [add, multiply, uppercase, lowercase, trim, prefix, suffix]
    default: uppercase
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [transform]
  - name: transform_value
    type: text
    label: Transform Operand
    description: The number for add and multiply, or the text for prefix and suffix.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [transform]
  - name: aggregate_field
    type: text
    label: Aggregate Field
    description: The numeric record field to reduce. Not needed for count.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [aggregate]
  - name: aggregate_function
    type: select
    label: Aggregate Function
    options: [sum, avg, min, max, count]
    default: sum
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [aggregate]
  - name: sort_field
    type: text
    label: Sort Field
    description: The record field to order by. Numbers sort before text; records without it go last.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [sort]
  - name: sort_direction
    type: select
    label: Sort Direction
    options: [ascending, descending]
    default: ascending
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [sort]
  - name: select_fields
    type: text
    label: Fields To Keep
    description: Comma-separated field names.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [select_fields]
  - name: normalize_field
    type: text
    label: Normalize Field
    description: The numeric record field to rescale.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [normalize]
  - name: normalize_min
    type: number
    label: Range Minimum
    default: 0
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [normalize]
  - name: normalize_max
    type: number
    label: Range Maximum
    default: 1
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [normalize]
component.name: JSON HANDLER (SYSTEM, READ-ONLY)

result.description: The operation's output. A list for every operation except aggregate (a number, or null for avg/min/max of no numbers) and extract (whatever sits at Array Path).

item_count.description: Length of result when it is a list, otherwise 0.

component.short_description: Reshapes a list of records - filter, sort, transform, aggregate, select fields or normalise - one operation per node.
